notes.title: Patch 1.03
notes.content:
Lost Nova has been out for 3 years! That's wild and strange to me. To celebrate, here's a small update for ya:

- improved performance, particularly when playing on laptops and lower-end systems
- improved load times
- added Borderless Fullscreen option

Thanks for playing my first game. Check out my other games too if you haven't yet. I'm working on my 4th one now :)
Jon

notes.title: Racing and Fashion and Pets! - April 2022 Devlog
notes.content:
[b]Hey friends![/b] We got a big post today. There's a lot to talk about! There's so many exciting things happening with Lost Nova that it's hard to keep up with. But let's try!

[h3][b]A Concerning Need for Speed[/b][/h3]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/3d1zJZ8.jpg[/img]

Sometimes you gotta go fast. In the Coral Ocean, you'll be able to do just that. If you do it well enough, you'll earn a prize. It's that simple! Just make sure you watch out for all the obstacles.


[h3][b]Clothes for your Head[/b][/h3]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/cjELrDx.jpg[/img]

Introducing the latest fashion craze: Head Clothes! In Lost Nova you'll be able to collect and wear an assortment of various head adornments. For fashion! Want to look like royalty? Want to look like you're taking a casual Springtime stroll through the fields? Want a suspicious leaf sprouting from your head? We got the fashion you need to make all these dreams come true.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/FcfBEEH.jpg[/img]

One such source for this fashion is unlocked later in the game. It's a bit isolated, but if you can find it, you'll discover more than just fashion dwelling within...


[h3][b]I Put a Dog in the Game[/b][/h3]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/KHbDrGB.jpg[/img]

It's true! In fact, there's a few different ghostly animals all ready and waiting for you to befriend them. It takes a bit of work for the pet shop to become available, but once it is? Oh man, that means it's time for FRIENDSHIP.

I won't say much more, but I will say that your pets, once befriended, perform a function beyond lifelong companionship. I hope you'll be pleasantly surprised!


[h3][b]Until Next Time[/b][/h3]
That's all for now! Until next time, please take a second to wishlist the game, if you haven't already. It really helps me out and the Steam algorithm really likes it!

<3
Jon

notes.title: Delivering Packages and Shooting Rocks - February 2022 Devlog
notes.content:
[b]Hey friends![/b] I continue to be absolutely, completely buried beneath a mountain of never-ending work. While I'm still here, my head poking out for a momentary breath of life-giving air, let me tell you about what's going on with Lost Nova lately!

[h3][b]He Has a Job for You[/b][/h3]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/faHcExa.png[/img]

At some point along your journey, this little apple dude will show up. No one knows how, but we do know why! They'll charge you with the task of delivering packages to the peoples of this world. 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/ljytSug.png[/img]

Once you find the correct recipient in one of the local towns and deliver them their package, you may find a new friend in need of delivering a new package, thus continuing the cycle. In exchange for this service, you'll receive currency. Which is how jobs work.

[h3][b]Breaking Rocks: More Fun Than Ever[/b][/h3]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/yatPu2e.gif[/img]

I figured that since shooting stuff with your laser is pretty much the main mechanic of the game, it'd be a good idea to go back and add some more feel and polish to it. Stuff you shoot now periodically pop out resources as you shoot it! They also do a little wiggle and puff out smoke. Like a little dance! Before being destroyed forever!

[h3][b]Until Next Time[/b][/h3]
That's all for now, I have to get back to work! Until next time, please take a second to [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1603410/Lost_Nova/]wishlist the game,[/url] if you haven't already. It really helps me out and the Steam algorithm really likes it!

<3
Jon

notes.title: Solving the In-Game Map Problem - November 2021 Devlog
notes.content:
There's a lot of different ways to do an in-game map. There's a lot of ways to get it right and a lot of ways to get it wrong. As the world of Lost Nova got bigger, I needed to start thinking about how to do my own in-game map. Here's the results!
 
[img]https://i.imgur.com/jLrPm8U.jpg[/img]

[b]Can you Read It?[/b]

Map readability was a top priority for me. As a rule, I used high-contrast colors and borders to really emphasize where you can and can't travel. I then immediately proceeded to break that rule for Secret Reasons.

[b]Where's the SECRETS[/b]

There's a lot of secrets in Lost Nova! Would putting them all on the map ruin the fun of exploration? I'm not sure. Instead, I decided to go with a sprinkling of little hints. Certain parts of each map are left open, alluding at hidden pathways. There are tiny pictograms to mark important locations and landmarks. Each map also displays which resources you can find in that area. I'm trying to help the player as much as I can without fully tipping my hand. A tricky thing to do when you're making a game primarily about exploration.

[b]How Do I, Jon, Even Make a Map?[/b]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/sNs6nur.jpg[/img]
 
I took screenshots of each area within the editor and traced them. It works!


[b]Other Neat Things[/b]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/nphc5Nv.gif[/img]
 
I did a lot more than just think a whole lot about maps since my previous devlog. In Lost Nova you can now:

[list]
[*] mow the lawn
[*] talk to a rock
[*] have multiple saves
[*] play with a controller!
[*] shoot a rock
[/list]
It's all really coming together!


[b]Until Next Time[/b]

That's all for now! I believe there's still one major zone in the game that I haven't talked about yet, but I'll save that for next time. Until then, don't forget to [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1603410/Lost_Nova/]wishlist the game[/url]. It really helps me out and the Steam algorithm really likes it!

<3
Jon

notes.title: July 2021 Devlog!
notes.content:
Hello friends! Here's the first in a series of devlogs leading up to the release of Lost Nova. Exciting!
I've been hard at work getting the main content of the game done. Having a game that you can actually play from start to finish is top priority! Even though I really, REALLY want to add that extremely complicated, non-essential minigame I've been dreaming about.


[h3]🏜️ [b]Painted Desert[/b][/h3]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/q6fmFho.png[/img]
 
The desert zone is by far the most complicated zone in the game so far. It has about as many art assets and NPCs as the first two zones combined. It also has the most scripted events and interactions! It's mostly done now though, allowing me start work on the next, extremely secret zone that will definitely, one hundred percent not be teased at the end of this post.


[h3]🌾 [b]"Farming"[/b][/h3]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/C4u4w7O.png[/img]
 
Behold the farms of the future!

I wanted you to have more to do every time you visit your main base so we have a little farming mechanic here. You'll be able to grow more of any of the glems you might need! The best part? It's the only farm where you harvest the crops with a laser beam.


[h3]💡 [b]An Idea for a Game[/b][/h3]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/y1lthbQ.jpg[/img]
 
I thought I'd share the very first piece of art created for Lost Nova! I drew this in the distant, forgotten past of September 2020. The game was a fresh ball of nebulous, potential energy then and I was really excited about where it could go. I had never made a game before but I had always been interested. This art and the staggering amount of rambling design notes I wrote along with it just would not let go of me until I made them real.

You might notice that most of this drawing turned into the desert zone we have today.


[h3]🐔 Chicken[/h3]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/7ZeTjQw.png[/img]
 
Every game needs one!

Thanks for reading, friends! I've been hard at work, trying my best to make sure this game is ready for you before the end of the year. Next time I think I'll be able to share some of the zone after the desert, the Coral Ocean!

- Jon
